name: China channel quote (Shenzhen/Huawei partner resellers, aggregated) price page for huawei-ascend-910b
notes: Mainstream single-card reference 100,000-120,000 CNY; 110,000 midpoint converted at 7.25 CNY/USD. Whole 8-card servers quote 1.3-1.7M CNY. 2024 contract pricing was ~100,000 CNY (Reuters), so the channel has firmed slightly. TRAP: 1,000 CNY Taobao '910B' listings are Atlas 300I A2 inference cards (32GB, different part), not the 64GB 910B OAM. Export-controlled; no US channel.
